title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q3 2021 vs Q3 2020

attempts.text: In Q3 2021, Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending increased by 24.0% compared to the same quarter last year. Restaurants & Café saw a significant increase in their average weekly value, growing by 316 million SAR, while Gas Stations experienced a 31.7% increase in their average weekly value. The change in average weekly value for Gas Stations was positive, up by 114.0%.
